operating_notes.text: Secured creditors due amount as on September 30, 2025 stood at ₹421.46 Cr for Hubtown.
Unsecured creditors due amount as on September 30, 2025 stood at ₹346.19 Cr for Hubtown and ₹84.80 Cr for Saicharan Consultancy.

Unsecured creditors approved the merger of Saicharan Consultancy with 100% votes in favour representing ₹114.56 Cr.

timeline.summary: Hubtown issued notice convening an NCLT-directed equity shareholders meeting on June 5, 2026 for the proposed merger of Saicharan Consultancy Private Limited.
Hubtown reported full year FY26 pre-sales of ₹4,382 Cr and collections of ₹1,910 Cr in an investor presentation.
Hubtown received an NCLT order dated May 04, 2026 to convene an equity shareholders meeting for the proposed merger of 25 West Realty Private Limited.
Promoters Hemant M. Shah, Vyomesh M. Shah, and 10 others declared no new encumbrances on Hubtown Limited shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹160 Cr; net profit to shareholders ₹22.81 Cr (includes ₹3.82 Cr from discontinued operations; continuing operations ₹30.04 Cr).
Hubtown released its monitoring agency report for Q4 FY26 showing full utilization of ₹1,209 Cr preferential issue proceeds.
Hubtown reported FY26 revenue of ₹644 Cr and proforma pre-sales of ₹4,382 Cr.
Hubtown issued notice for the NCLT-convened equity shareholders meeting on June 19, 2026, for the merger of 25 West Realty.
Hubtown reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹160 Cr and net profit to owners of ₹22.81 Cr.
Hubtown published its investor presentation for Q4 and FY26, highlighting proforma pre-sales of ₹43,823 Mn and ongoing debt reduction.
Hubtown uploaded the audio recording of its Q4 & FY26 investor/analyst meeting on May 21, 2026.
Hubtown hosted its Q4 and FY26 analyst meet on May 20, 2026, reporting ₹4,400 Cr pre-sales and outlining merger and project execution plans.
On June 5, 2026, Hubtown held its NCLT-convened equity shareholders meeting where the scheme of arrangement for the merger of Saicharan Consultancy Private Limited was approved.
On June 8, 2026, Hubtown reported that its unsecured creditors unanimously approved the merger scheme with Saicharan Consultancy Private Limited.
Hubtown increased its shareholding in subsidiary Rare Townships Private Limited to 75.24% via a ₹3.26 Cr rights issue allotment.
Hubtown reported Q2FY27 consolidated financial results featuring an auditor qualification on unprovided interest.
